problems: zhou-dynasty and the ancient part of later-zhou are one state (the Zhou royal house, 1046-256 BC). zhou-dynasty.json ends at Cliopatria's handoff (751) with a dissolve to the suggested slug eastern-zhou and successors = the Spring and Autumn states' 750 shapes; the batch that splits 'Later Zhou' must start its ancient dossier at 751 (or at 770 with this one shortened) and share colour continuity (family china), or the reviewer merges both into zhou-dynasty.

Cliopatria's Chu shapes of 750 and 700 (353,000 km2, north to 34.7 N) are far too large for the 8th century and cover Shangcai and Huaiyang, so Cliopatria drew Cai 120 km and Chen 80 km north of their real seats; both small states' shapes are marked wrong with place corrections and the Chu shapes are adjusted (enclaves cut out, 750 shape cut to Hubei-Hunan). The gazetteer agent should add Shangcai, Xincai and Zhumadian so the corrections resolve.
Cao (Q204077) and Cao Cao are different entities (Zhou-era fief vs the Han warlord's domain): two dossiers; the Cao Cao row needs its own Wikidata id.

Cliopatria year errors seen: Cai/Chen/Cao all end 451 (pages: 447/479/487); Shang ends 1001 (1046); Zhou starts 1000 (1046); Chu ends 224 (223); Xu runs to 285 though annexed 512; Wu runs to 451 though destroyed 473; Zhu (ends 405) is the Zou annexed c. 348.

Counterpart dossiers that must carry matching events: song (gain Cao 487; loss of its Chu share 286), wu (occupation of Ying 506-505), qin (Hanzhong 312, Chongqiu 301, eight cities 299, Ying 278, Chu 223, Wei valley after 771), lu (loss 249), yue (partition 333), xu (512), zhu (348).
